verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Chroma publishes an llms.txt at docs.trychroma.com/llms.txt that indexes Markdown versions of its doc pages. The getting-started docs also provide a ready-made prompt to hand to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or other agents, so agent-oriented docs are a first-party capability. Missing for 10: evidence of how completely llms.txt covers the docs (e.g. a full-content variant), and independent user reports of agents consuming these docs successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.trychroma.com/llms.txt # Chroma Docs
Give the following prompt to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or your favorite AI agent. It will quickly set you up with Chroma.
